senses.en: showing great care and persistent effort

example.en: She was assiduous in keeping every record up to date.
example.zh: 她勤勉地把每份记录都保持更新。

senses.en: mail carried by aircraft; the system of sending mail by air

example.en: Send the letter by airmail so it arrives faster.
example.zh: 这封信用航空邮寄，这样到得更快。

senses.en: to send something by air mail

example.en: She airmailed the documents to London.
example.zh: 她把文件航空寄到了伦敦。

senses.en: to arrange or organize according to a system

example.en: She systematised the files by year and subject.
example.zh: 她按年份和主题将文件系统化整理。

senses.en: relating to someone's life story or biography

example.en: The book contains biographic details about the artist's early years.
example.zh: 这本书包含有关这位艺术家早年生活的传记性细节。

senses.en: sticks of wax with a wick that give light when burned

example.en: We lit candles when the power went out.
example.zh: 停电时我们点起了蜡烛。

senses.en: electronic machines that store and process data

example.en: Most offices rely on computers to handle daily work.
example.zh: 大多数办公室都依靠电脑处理日常工作。

senses.en: to show pain or discomfort with a quick movement of the face or body

example.en: She winced as the nurse cleaned the cut.
example.zh: 护士清洗伤口时她疼得一皱眉。

senses.en: a quick movement of the face showing pain or discomfort

example.en: A slight wince crossed his face.
example.zh: 他脸上闪过一丝痛苦的表情。

senses.en: the part of a town or city next to the sea, a river, or a lake

example.en: The city built a lovely promenade along its waterfront.
example.zh: 这座城市沿着滨水区修建了一条漂亮的步行道。

senses.en: to become liquid, usually as a result of heating

example.en: The ice melts quickly in the sun.
example.zh: 冰在阳光下很快融化。

senses.en: to cause a solid to become liquid, usually by heating it

example.en: Melt the butter in a small pan.
example.zh: 在小锅里把黄油熔化。

senses.en: to gradually disappear or become less strong

example.en: The morning fog melted away by noon.
example.zh: 晨雾到中午时逐渐消散。

senses.en: a statement saying that someone has done something wrong, often without proof
senses.zh: 指称某人做了错事的说法，通常尚无证据

example.en: She strongly denied the allegation that she had taken the money.
example.zh: 她坚决否认自己拿了那笔钱的指控。

senses.en: a formal accusation made in a legal case
senses.zh: （法律）法律案件中的正式指控

example.en: The court will examine the allegation in the complaint.
example.zh: 法院将审查起诉状中的指控。

senses.en: wet, soft earth or soil

example.en: The children came home with mud on their shoes.
example.zh: 孩子们回家时鞋上沾着泥。

senses.en: unfair or hostile remarks intended to damage someone's reputation

example.en: The campaign threw mud at the rival candidate.
example.zh: 竞选活动对对手候选人进行了抹黑。

senses.en: Physical injury or damage to a person or body part.

example.en: The fall caused serious harm to his knee.
example.zh: 这次跌倒严重伤了他的膝盖。

senses.en: A bad effect on something such as the environment or someone's interests.

example.en: The new policy may do more harm than good.
example.zh: 这项新政策可能弊大于利。

senses.en: To injure someone or damage something.

example.en: Chemicals can harm wildlife.
example.zh: 化学物质会伤害野生动物。

senses.en: a group of people who work together for a shared purpose

example.en: She works for a nonprofit organization that helps local families.
example.zh: 她在一家帮助当地家庭的非营利组织工作。

senses.en: the act or process of arranging people or things to work together effectively

example.en: Good organization made the event run smoothly.
example.zh: 良好的组织使活动顺利进行。

senses.en: an organized system or structure

example.en: The report explains the organization of the healthcare system.
example.zh: 报告说明了医疗保健系统的组织结构。

senses.en: hopeful and focused on good things or solutions

example.en: She stayed positive despite the delays.
example.zh: 尽管有延误，她仍保持积极。

senses.en: sure or certain about something

example.en: Are you positive that you locked the door?
example.zh: 你确定你锁门了吗？

senses.en: a good or useful aspect of a situation

example.en: The plan has several positives, including lower costs.
example.zh: 这个计划有几个优点，包括成本较低。

senses.en: Completely, or to the highest degree.

example.en: The room was absolutely silent.
example.zh: 房间里完全寂静无声。

senses.en: Used to express strong agreement or a definite answer.
senses.zh: （表示强烈同意或明确肯定）当然，绝对

example.en: “Are you sure?” “Absolutely.”
example.zh: “你确定吗？”“当然。”

senses.en: a ceremony at which two people get married

example.en: They invited us to their wedding in June.
example.zh: 他们邀请我们参加他们六月的婚礼。

senses.en: the reception or celebration connected with a marriage ceremony

example.en: The wedding reception will be in the garden.
example.zh: 婚宴将在花园里举行。

senses.en: a person who enters a building illegally to steal things

example.en: The burglar broke into the house through a back window.
example.zh: 窃贼从后窗闯入了那所房子。

senses.en: not letting water pass through; resistant to water

example.en: This watch is waterproof, so you can wear it while swimming.
example.zh: 这块手表是防水的，所以游泳时可以戴着。

senses.en: to treat something so that water cannot pass through it

example.en: They waterproofed the roof before the rainy season.
example.zh: 他们在雨季前给屋顶做了防水处理。

senses.en: a waterproof garment, especially a raincoat

example.en: Take a waterproof with you in case it rains.
example.zh: 带上一件雨衣，以防下雨。

senses.en: a long period of history marked by important events or developments

example.en: The invention of the internet opened a new epoch in human history.
example.zh: 互联网的发明开启了人类历史的新纪元。

senses.en: (geology) a division of geological time, shorter than a period

example.en: This rock formation dates back to the Pleistocene epoch.
example.zh: 这一岩层形成于更新世。

senses.en: the front or leading position, especially in the phrase to the fore
senses.zh: 前部；显著地位（尤用于 to the fore）

example.en: New concerns came to the fore during the meeting.
example.zh: 会上，新的担忧凸显出来。

senses.en: located at or toward the front, especially of a ship

example.en: The fore cabin is smaller than the one at the back.
example.zh: 前面的船舱比后面的小。

senses.en: toward or near the front of a ship or aircraft

example.en: The ship pitched fore and aft.
example.zh: 这艘船前后颠簸。

senses.en: a warning shouted when a golf ball is heading toward someone
senses.zh: 当心！（高尔夫球飞向他人时的警示语）

example.en: The golfer shouted 'Fore!' as the ball flew toward the spectators.
example.zh: 球飞向观众时，高尔夫球手大喊：“当心！”

senses.en: far away from other places or people; remote

example.en: They live in an isolated village high in the mountains.
example.zh: 他们住在大山深处一个偏远的村庄里。

senses.en: separate from others; happening or existing alone

example.en: The incident was described as an isolated case.
example.zh: 这起事件被描述为一个孤立的个案。

senses.en: feeling lonely or apart from others

example.en: Many new students feel isolated during their first weeks at college.
example.zh: 许多新生在入学头几周会感到孤单。

senses.en: to combine with oxygen, or to make something combine with oxygen

example.en: Iron oxidizes quickly when exposed to moist air.
example.zh: 铁暴露在潮湿空气中会很快氧化。

senses.en: including the latest information or changes
senses.zh: 最新的；包含最新信息的

example.en: The website provides up-to-date weather information.
example.zh: 这个网站提供最新的天气信息。

senses.en: modern and following current styles or methods

example.en: The office has up-to-date equipment.
example.zh: 办公室配备了现代化的设备。

senses.en: a nation with its own government and territory

example.en: China is a country with a long history.
example.zh: 中国是一个历史悠久的国家。

senses.en: land away from towns, used for farming or in a natural state

example.en: They spent the weekend walking in the country.
example.zh: 他们在乡间散步度过了周末。

senses.en: an area or region of land

example.en: This is beautiful hill country.
example.zh: 这里是美丽的山区地带。

senses.en: present or in use now; currently in place

example.en: We need to update the existing system rather than build a new one.
example.zh: 我们需要更新现有系统，而不是建一个新的。

senses.en: present participle of exist: to be real or to be present
senses.zh: 存在；生存（exist 的现在分词）

example.en: Animals existing in the desert have special ways to survive the heat.
example.zh: 生活在沙漠中的动物有在炎热中生存的特殊本领。

senses.en: decorated with pieces of material set into a surface

example.en: The table has an inlaid pattern of dark wood.
example.zh: 这张桌子有深色木头镶嵌的图案。

senses.en: a skilled public speaker

example.en: She is a brilliant orator who can move any audience.
example.zh: 她是一位出色的演说家，能打动任何听众。

senses.en: complete agreement by everyone

example.en: The committee reached unanimity on the new policy.
example.zh: 委员会就新政策达成了一致。

senses.en: to obtain money or something valuable from someone by threats or force

example.en: The gang was charged with extorting money from local shopkeepers.
example.zh: 该团伙被控向当地店主勒索钱财。

senses.en: a musician who plays the trumpet

example.en: The trumpeter played a brilliant solo.
example.zh: 小号手演奏了一段精彩的独奏。

senses.en: a person who publicly announces or praises something

example.en: He was a trumpeter of the new policy.
example.zh: 他是新政策的鼓吹者。

senses.en: an aquatic animal with a hard shell and segmented body, such as a crab or lobster

example.en: Crabs and lobsters are common crustaceans.
example.zh: 螃蟹和龙虾是常见的甲壳纲动物。

senses.en: a person who becomes involved in a place or situation where they are not wanted

example.en: The locals regarded the new investors as interlopers.
example.zh: 当地人把新来的投资者视为闯入者。

senses.en: a vehicle used to carry a coffin to a funeral or cemetery

example.en: A black hearse slowly led the funeral procession.
example.zh: 一辆黑色灵车缓缓引领着送葬队伍。

senses.en: to cut a body into pieces; to divide a country or organization into parts

example.en: The empire was dismembered after the war.
example.zh: 战后帝国被瓜分了。

senses.en: a large deciduous tree with tough wood, often planted for shade

example.en: An old elm shaded the front of the house.
example.zh: 一棵老榆树荫蔽着房子的前面。

senses.en: a supporter of federalism or a strong federal government

example.en: As a federalist, he argued for shared power between national and state governments.
example.zh: 作为联邦派，他主张国家与州政府分享权力。

senses.en: the act of paying back money that was borrowed; the money paid back

example.en: He struggled to keep up with the monthly repayments on his loan.
example.zh: 他难以按时偿还每月的贷款。

senses.en: to go away from a place or person

example.en: She leaves for work at eight.
example.zh: 她八点动身去上班。

senses.en: to let something stay where it is; not take it with you

example.en: Leave your keys on the table.
example.zh: 把钥匙放在桌上。

senses.en: time away from work for rest or another purpose

example.en: He took three days' leave.
example.zh: 他请了三天假。

senses.en: a thick slice of beef, usually cooked by grilling or frying

example.en: We had steak and potatoes for dinner.
example.zh: 我们晚餐吃了牛排和土豆。

senses.en: a thick slice of fish or other meat

example.en: She ordered a salmon steak.
example.zh: 她点了一份三文鱼排。

senses.en: a small part or amount that shows what the whole is like

example.en: The doctor took a blood sample.
example.zh: 医生取了一份血样。

senses.en: to take or try a small part of something to learn about it

example.en: We sampled the soup before adding salt.
example.zh: 加盐前我们尝了尝汤。

senses.en: to run or move very quickly

example.en: She dashed across the street to catch the bus.
example.zh: 她飞快地冲过马路去赶公交车。

senses.en: a quick run or sudden movement

example.en: He made a dash for the exit.
example.zh: 他冲向出口。

senses.en: the punctuation mark (—) used to separate or emphasize parts of a sentence

example.en: Use a dash to add extra information to a sentence.
example.zh: 用破折号给句子添加补充信息。

senses.en: to destroy a hope or plan suddenly
senses.zh: 使（希望、计划）落空；使破灭

example.en: The rain dashed our hopes of a picnic.
example.zh: 这场雨让我们野餐的希望落空了。

senses.en: to ruin or damage the quality or value of something

example.en: The rain spoiled our picnic.
example.zh: 雨破坏了我们的野餐。

senses.en: to give a child whatever they want, so they behave badly

example.en: Grandparents often spoil their grandchildren.
example.zh: 祖父母常常溺爱孙辈。

senses.en: to become unfit to eat

example.en: Milk spoils quickly if left out of the fridge.
example.zh: 牛奶放在冰箱外很快就会变质。

senses.en: goods or valuables taken by force, especially in war (usually plural)

example.en: The victors divided the spoils of war.
example.zh: 胜利者瓜分了战利品。

senses.en: to act as chairperson of a meeting or ceremony

example.en: She will preside over the annual meeting next week.
example.zh: 她下周将主持年度会议。

senses.en: to be in charge or have authority over something

example.en: A judge presides over the courtroom proceedings.
example.zh: 法官主持法庭审理。

senses.en: used to say that the opposite of what has just been said is also true

example.en: Large companies can afford lower prices; conversely, small shops often charge more.
example.zh: 大公司能承受更低的价格；反过来，小商店往往要价更高。

senses.en: the scientific study of living organisms

example.en: She is studying biology at university.
example.zh: 她在大学学习生物学。

senses.en: the life processes and behavior of living organisms
senses.zh: 生物的生命现象与活动规律

example.en: The biology of whales is still not fully understood.
example.zh: 鲸鱼的生命活动规律尚未被完全了解。

senses.en: a large public meeting to show support or enthusiasm

example.en: Thousands of people attended the campaign rally.
example.zh: 数千人参加了这次竞选集会。

senses.en: to recover strength or improve after a decline or difficulty

example.en: The patient rallied after the treatment.
example.zh: 病人经治疗后恢复了体力。

senses.en: to gather people together, especially for support or action

example.en: The leader rallied her supporters before the vote.
example.zh: 投票前，这位领袖把支持者团结了起来。

senses.en: a rise in prices or an exchange of strokes in tennis or badminton
senses.zh: （价格）回升；（网球等的）连续对打

example.en: The stock market saw a strong rally this week.
example.zh: 本周股市强劲回升。

senses.en: a narrow strip of fabric used for tying or decorating

example.en: She tied a red ribbon around the gift box.
example.zh: 她用红丝带把礼品盒系了起来。

senses.en: a long narrow strip-like object or marking

example.en: A thin ribbon of smoke rose from the chimney.
example.zh: 一缕带状的烟从烟囱升起。

senses.en: a strip awarded as a prize or mark of honor

example.en: He won a blue ribbon at the county fair.
example.zh: 他在县博览会上赢得了一等奖（蓝绶带）。

senses.en: to watch over and direct a person, activity, or work

example.en: She supervises a team of ten engineers.
example.zh: 她管理一个由十名工程师组成的团队。

senses.en: a personal charm that makes people admire and follow you

example.en: The leader's charisma won the crowd's support.
example.zh: 这位领袖的个人魅力赢得了人群的支持。

senses.en: to change completely in form, appearance, or nature

example.en: The artist transmuted ordinary materials into striking works of art.
example.zh: 这位艺术家把普通材料转化成了引人注目的艺术作品。

senses.en: a thief who steals from people's pockets or bags in public places

example.en: A pickpocket stole her phone on the crowded bus.
example.zh: 一个扒手在拥挤的公交车上偷走了她的手机。

senses.en: completely sealed so that no air can get in or out

example.en: The container has a hermetic seal to keep the food fresh.
example.zh: 容器有密封封口以保持食物新鲜。

senses.en: a wide view of a large area of land or scenery

example.en: From the mountain top we enjoyed a breathtaking panorama of the valley.
example.zh: 从山顶上，我们欣赏到山谷令人惊叹的全景。

senses.en: memorizing something by repetition without really understanding it

example.en: She learned the poem by rote and could recite it perfectly.
example.zh: 她靠死记硬背学会了这首诗，能一字不差地背出来。

senses.en: a truck that collects household rubbish (British English)

example.en: The dustcart comes every Tuesday morning.
example.zh: 垃圾车每周二早上来。

senses.en: substances that things can be made from

example.en: We need to buy some materials for the school project.
example.zh: 我们需要为学校项目买一些材料。

senses.en: information or items used for study, teaching or work

example.en: The teacher handed out reading materials before class.
example.zh: 老师课前发了阅读资料。

senses.en: cloth or fabric

example.en: This dress is made of a soft, comfortable material.
example.zh: 这条裙子是用柔软舒适的面料做的。

senses.en: people who travel to visit places for pleasure

example.en: Thousands of tourists visit the old town every summer.
example.zh: 每年夏天有成千上万的游客参观这座古镇。
